propositions: Implement a deterministic AST ownership gate in `scripts/check_config_ownership.py` that enforces centralized composition roots and rejects direct/aliased environment access, backend property reloads, and configurable adapter defaults outside approved seams.
Wire the ownership gate through `make lint` and CI workflows alongside the existing field-consumption gate, and ensure CI parity tests prevent silent omission of either gate.

Generate authoritative configuration precedence, lifecycle, and security documentation from schema and ownership registries in `docs/config.md` and `docs/security.md`, covering MCP/CLI exposure, restart/redeploy rotation, and provider-neutral behavior deltas.

Remove all legacy ambient/per-job facades, migration switches, and exception entries only after focused behavioral suites, bounded provider canaries, and live reconciler checks pass with redacted evidence and no credential leakage.

Maintain S1-S6 behavioral oracles as the correctness authority; structural ownership gates serve as change detectors, not security sandboxes, and retain snapshot-envelope compatibility floor for rollback.
